messages:
Hannah Cho: Quick sync for NimbusSilicon EAP (Nimbus-N2). NDA is signed; partner wants a lightweight preview card and joint blog after we validate. Need bench window, telemetry sampling, and embargo window by next Tue.
Miguel Soto: Can they provide firmware/images by Mon AM? would like to run our compatibility suite on `rc/nimbus-n2`.
Legal Bot: NDA: executed. Partner requested 14-day embargo after internal signoff. Flagged no additional redlines.
Hannah Cho: Bench Ops, can you reserve a 3-hour slot Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC? partner prefers late-night.
Bench Ops: Reserved Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC. Bench job queued: NB-N2-EAP-6102. Logs will land in /runs/NB-N2-EAP-6102. Upload configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/nimbus/eap-configs.
Miguel Soto: Proposed bench matrix: models=[rwd-13b], ctx=[8k,16k], modes=[fp16,quant8]. Preview targets: p50<75ms p95<280ms @8k. Also include cold-start runs.
Hannah Cho: Telemetry plan: 0.5% token sampling, prefix cache hit/miss, anonymized traces only. Legal Bot confirmed privacy OK.
runtime-bot: Please add fallback path `nimbus-n2-quant` in runtime config to handle memory pressure. snippet: {"fallback":"nimbus-quant","metrics_tag":"nimbus-eap"}
Marketplace Team: I'll draft the preview listing copy and partner badge. Will avoid GA wording. Draft link uploaded.
Miguel Soto: Command I'll run (dev): `./ci/bench --target nimbus-n2 --model rwd-13b --ctx 8192 --mode fp16 --warmup 600 --samples 150 --cold-start`
Hannah Cho: Action items: Miguel push harness + run (Due: Tue slot), Bench Ops collect artifacts + upload (Due: Wed EOD), Marketplace prepare preview copy (Due: Wed). Sync Mon 11:00 PT to confirm images. :thumbsup:
